verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an API-first inference cloud. It can be driven non-interactively from code: an OpenAI-compatible API authenticated with an API token, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and automation-friendly controls such as fail_fast returning HTTP 429 and flex tier for asynchronous workloads. However, it documents no CI-specific guidance or headless CLI. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions examples, secret/env-var setup), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Point your existing OpenAI SDK to `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai` and your code works without changes.
Set the optional fail_fast parameter to true to get an immediate HTTP 429 instead of waiting.
It’s ideal for non-production or lower-priority tasks such as model evaluations, data enrichment, and asynchronous workloads.
